title: Soft & looks great but NOT easy to get fur off!
text: Soft & looks great but NOT easy to get fur off!. Got these because reviews were great & it was super easy to fit to our couch however we have 3 dogs & a cat... the fur is EVERYWHERE. It is almost impossible to vacuum out & doesn't come out in the wash either. Huge bummer but still giving 3 stars for the comfort & ease of install.
